# Prepare

```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
from python_scripts import routes
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import seaborn.objects as so
import seaborn as sns

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence import variance_inflation_factor as sm_vif
import scipy.stats as ss
import itertools
import json
from IPython.display import Markdown

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
dpw_pls_orig = dpw_pls
odds_r_tables = []
figure_major_i = 9
figure_minor_i = 0
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05


def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl


def cols_with_dummies(cols, dummy_cols):
    return sum([dummy_cols[col] if col in dummy_cols.keys() else [col] for col in cols], [])


def get_ivs(dv, cols_to_exclude, selected_chrs=None):
    global dpw_pls, dpw_rt_starts, dpw_clis, characteristics
    if selected_chrs is None:
        iv_cols_used = sum(characteristics.values(), [])
    else:
        iv_cols_used = sum(selected_chrs.values(), [])
    iv_cols_used = [col for col in iv_cols_used if col not in cols_to_exclude]
    # Get relevant IVs
    idx_type = dv.index.name
    match idx_type:
        case "vac_id":
            iv_df = dpw_pls
        case "route_id":
            iv_df = dpw_rt_starts
        case "o_cli_id":
            iv_df = dpw_clis
    iv_df = iv_df[[idx_type] + iv_cols_used].set_index(idx_type).loc[dv.index]

    # Add non-categorical variables
    Xarr = [iv_df.select_dtypes(exclude="category")]

    # Add dummies for categorical variables
    ref_cats = {}
    dummy_cols = {}
    na_values = ["_[Missing data]", "_Unknown"]
    cat_cols = iv_df.select_dtypes(include="category")
    for col, content in cat_cols.items():
        cat_cols[col] = cat_cols[col].replace(na_values, pd.NA)
        cat_order = list(cat_cols[col].value_counts().index)
        ref_cats[col] = f"{col}_{cat_order[0]}"  # Reference category is most common one
        cat_cols[col] = cat_cols[col].cat.reorder_categories(cat_order)
        # Get dummies for this characteristic
        Xn = pd.get_dummies(cat_cols[col], prefix=col, drop_first=True).astype("boolean")
        Xn.loc[cat_cols[col].isnull()] = pd.NA
        dummy_cols[col] = list(Xn.columns)
        Xarr.append(Xn)
    binaries = list(iv_df.select_dtypes(include="boolean").columns)

    col_order = cols_with_dummies(iv_cols_used, dummy_cols)

    X = pd.concat(Xarr, axis=1)[col_order]
    # X = X.dropna()

    # Add a constant to ensure intercept is calculated
    Xc = sm.add_constant(X).rename(columns={"const": "(Intercept)"})
    return X, Xc, iv_df, iv_cols_used, ref_cats, binaries, dummy_cols


def dv_xc_remove_value(dv, xc, cols_d, value):
    selected_xc = Xc[~Xc[value]].drop(columns=value)
    selected_dv = dv.loc[selected_xc.index]
    cols_d = [x for x in cols_d if x != value]
    return selected_dv, selected_xc, cols_d


def chi2_cramers(iv_df_used, iv1, iv2):
    ct = pd.crosstab(iv_df_used[iv1], iv_df_used[iv2])
    chi2, pvalue, dof, arr = ss.chi2_contingency(ct)
    if pvalue < 0.001:
        p_sig = "***"
    elif pvalue < 0.01:
        p_sig = "**"
    elif pvalue < alpha:
        p_sig = "*"
    else:
        p_sig = ""
    cr_v = ss.contingency.association(ct, method="cramer")
    return (chi2, pvalue, p_sig, dof, cr_v)


def iv_assoc(iv_df, iv_cols):
    iv_df_used = iv_df[iv_cols]
    iv_df_used = iv_df_used.dropna()
    # Test chi squared and Cramer's V for contingency tables
    iv_prod = [(iv1, iv2)
               for iv1, iv2
               in itertools.product(iv_df_used.select_dtypes(exclude="number").columns, repeat=2)
               if iv1 != iv2]
    results = (pd.DataFrame([(iv1, iv2) + chi2_cramers(iv_df_used, iv1, iv2) for iv1, iv2 in iv_prod],
                            columns=["iv1", "iv2", "chi2", "p", "*", "df", "V"]))
    results["iv1"] = pd.Categorical(results["iv1"], categories=iv_cols)
    results["iv2"] = pd.Categorical(results["iv2"], categories=iv_cols)
    results["*"] = pd.Categorical(results["*"], categories=["", "*", "**", "***"])
    short_ivs = results["iv2"].cat.categories.str.replace(r"^(.)[^_]*|_(.)[^_]*", r"\1\2", regex=True)
    results["iv2"] = results["iv2"].cat.rename_categories(short_ivs)
    disp = results.pivot(index="iv2", columns="iv1", values=["V", "*"]).T.swaplevel().sort_index(ascending=[True, False])
    results["iv2"] = results["iv2"].cat.rename_categories(iv_cols)
    return results, disp


def vif(Xc):
    vif_data = pd.DataFrame()
    vif_data["Feature"] = Xc.columns
    vif_data["VIF"] = [sm_vif(Xc.dropna().astype("float").values, i) for i in range(len(Xc.columns))]
    vif_data = vif_data.set_index("Feature").sort_values("VIF", ascending=False)
    return vif_data


def binomial_regression(dv, Xc, cols_to_remove, dummy_cols):
    global prev_results
    selectedXc = Xc.loc[:, ~Xc.columns.isin(cols_with_dummies(cols_to_remove, dummy_cols))].dropna()
    selecteddv = dv.loc[selectedXc.index]
    results = sm.Logit(selecteddv, selectedXc.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    coef = params.rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues = pvalues.rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef = prev_coef.rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef = coef.rename("coef")
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_coef.loc[coef.index], coef], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    prev_results = results
    display(summary)
    results_or = results_or.loc[results_or["p"].sort_values(ascending=False).index]
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
        display(results_or)
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    print("-" * 50)
    print("")
    return results, summary, results_or


def multinomial_regression(dv, Xc, cols_to_remove, dummy_cols):
    global prev_results
    selectedXc = Xc.loc[:, ~Xc.columns.isin(cols_with_dummies(cols_to_remove, dummy_cols))].dropna()
    selecteddv = dv.loc[selectedXc.index]
    results = sm.MNLogit(selecteddv, selectedXc.astype("float")).fit()
    summary = results.summary(alpha=alpha)
    params = results.params
    params.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    coef = params.unstack().rename("odds_r")
    ci = results.conf_int()
    ci.columns = [f"[{alpha/2:.3f}", f"{1-alpha/2:.3f}]"]
    odds_ratios = np.exp(pd.concat([coef, ci], axis=1))
    pvalues = results.pvalues
    pvalues.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
    pvalues = pvalues.unstack().rename("p")
    pvalues_sig = (pvalues <= alpha).replace({True: "*", False: ""}).rename("*")
    results_or = pd.concat([pvalues, pvalues_sig, odds_ratios], axis=1)
    results_or.columns.name = "Odds Ratios"
    if len(cols_to_remove) != 0:
        summary.add_extra_txt([f"Variables removed: {cols_to_remove}"])
        prev_coef = prev_results.params
        prev_coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        prev_coef = prev_coef.unstack().rename("prev_coef")
        coef = results.params
        coef.columns = list(dv.cat.categories[1:])
        coef = coef.unstack().rename("coef")
        diff = (pd.concat([prev_coef.loc[coef.index], coef], axis=1)
                .assign(diff_pct=lambda x: 100*(x.diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]/x["prev_coef"]).round(3)))
        results_or = pd.concat([results_or, diff], axis=1)
    prev_results = results
    display(summary)
    results_or = results_or.loc[results_or["p"].groupby(level=1).transform("min").sort_values(ascending=False).index].swaplevel()
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format, "display.max_rows", 120):
        display(results_or.head(120))
    print(f"Psuedo R^2: {results.prsquared}")
    print("-" * 50)
    print("")
    return results, summary, results_or


def plot_odds_r(dv_str, dv_ref_cat, iv_ref_cats, results_or_final, x_max=None, wrap=None, replacements={}, theme={}, figsize=(9.5, 6), cols_removed=[]):
    global figure_major_i, figure_minor_i
    f_i = f"{figure_major_i}.{figure_minor_i}"
    plot_or = results_or_final.dropna()
    ci_lo = plot_or.columns[-2]
    ci_hi = plot_or.columns[-1]

    if results.llr_pvalue < 0.001:
        pvalue_text = r"$p<0.001$. "
    else:
        pvalue_text = r"$p=" + f"{results.llr_pvalue:.3f}$. "
    if len(cols_removed) == 0:
        excluded_variables_text = "No variables excluded."
    else:
        excluded_variables_text = "Variables excluded (not statistically significant in this model): " + ", ".join(cols_removed) + "."
    footer_text = (r"Model statistics: pseudo-$R^2=" + f"{results.prsquared:.3f}$, " + pvalue_text + excluded_variables_text)

    if type(plot_or.index) is pd.MultiIndex:
        # 1. Remove Intercept rows
        plot_or = plot_or.drop(index=plot_or.loc[(slice(None), "(Intercept)"), :].index)
        # 2. Add iv_ref_cat rows with odds_r and both C.I.s == 1.0 for IVs still in the model
        ref_cat_data = {"p": pd.NA, "*": "", "odds_r": 1.0, ci_lo: 1.0, ci_hi: 1.0}
        ref_cat_idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(itertools.product(plot_or.index.levels[0], iv_ref_cats.values()))
        ref_cat_df = pd.DataFrame(data=ref_cat_data, index=ref_cat_idx)
        ref_cat_title_data = {"p": pd.NA, "*": "", "odds_r": pd.NA, ci_lo: pd.NA, ci_hi: pd.NA}
        ref_cat_title_bold = {i: r"$\bf{" + i.replace("_", r"\ ") + "}$" for i in iv_ref_cats.keys()}
        ref_cat_title_idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_tuples(itertools.product(plot_or.index.levels[0], iv_ref_cats.keys()))
        ref_cat_title_df = pd.DataFrame(data=ref_cat_title_data, index=ref_cat_title_idx)
        plot_or = pd.concat([plot_or, ref_cat_df, ref_cat_title_df]).sort_index().rename_axis(index=["dv", "iv"]).reset_index()
        # Shorten IVs by separating into groups
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].str.replace("|".join([x + "_" for x in iv_ref_cats.keys()]), "", regex=True)
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].replace(ref_cat_title_bold)
        # Bold binaries
        binaries_bold = {i: r"$\bf{" + i.replace("_", r"\ ") + "}$" for i in binaries}
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].replace(binaries_bold)
        # short_ivs = plot_or.index.levels[1].str.replace("|".join([x + "_" for x in iv_ref_cats.keys()]), "", regex=True)
        # 3. Add title "vs dv_ref_cat"
        # plot_or.index = plot_or.index.set_levels(plot_or.index.levels[0] + "\nvs.\n" + dv_ref_cat, level=0)
        # plot_or.index = plot_or.index + "\nvs.\n" + dv_ref_cat
        plot_or["dv"] = plot_or["dv"] + "\nvs.\n" + dv_ref_cat
    else:
        # 1. Remove Intercept rows
        plot_or = plot_or.drop(index="(Intercept)")
        # 2. Add iv_ref_cat rows with odds_r and both C.I.s == 1.0 for IVs still in the model
        ref_cat_data = {"p": pd.NA, "*": "", "odds_r": 1.0, ci_lo: 1.0, ci_hi: 1.0}
        ref_cat_idx = list(iv_ref_cats.values())
        ref_cat_df = pd.DataFrame(data=ref_cat_data, index=ref_cat_idx)
        ref_cat_title_data = {"p": pd.NA, "*": "", "odds_r": pd.NA, ci_lo: pd.NA, ci_hi: pd.NA}
        ref_cat_title_bold = {i: r"$\bf{" + i.replace("_", r"\ ") + "}$" for i in iv_ref_cats.keys()}
        ref_cat_title_idx = iv_ref_cats.keys()
        ref_cat_title_df = pd.DataFrame(data=ref_cat_title_data, index=ref_cat_title_idx)
        plot_or = pd.concat([plot_or, ref_cat_df, ref_cat_title_df]).sort_index().rename_axis(index="iv").reset_index()
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].str.replace("|".join([x + "_" for x in iv_ref_cats.keys()]), "", regex=True)
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].replace(ref_cat_title_bold)
        binaries_bold = {i: r"$\bf{" + i.replace("_", r"\ ") + "}$" for i in binaries}
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].replace(binaries_bold)

    for pat, repl in replacements.items():
        plot_or["iv"] = plot_or["iv"].str.replace(pat, repl)
    plot_or["*"] = (plot_or["*"] == "*") & plot_or["*"].notna()
    # lines = plot_or[["dv", "iv"]].assign(line_1=1)
    # log_plot_or = pd.concat([plot_or.iloc[:, :-3], np.log(plot_or.iloc[:, -3:])], axis=1)
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=figsize)
    fig.suptitle("Odds ratios for " + dv_str[:1].lower() + dv_str[1:], wrap=True)
    txt = fig.supxlabel(t=footer_text, x=0.01, y=0.01, ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize="small", wrap=True)
    # fig_top, fig_bottom = fig.subfigures(2, 1, height_ratios=[44, 1])
    # fig_top = fig
    # fig_bottom = fig
    if x_max is None:
        max_x_axis_exp = 1.04 * np.log(plot_or[ci_hi].max())
        min_x_axis_exp_mag = 1.04 * abs(np.log(plot_or[ci_lo].min()))
        max_x_axis_exp = max(max_x_axis_exp, min_x_axis_exp_mag)
        max_x_axis_exp = np.log(10) if max_x_axis_exp < np.log(10) else max_x_axis_exp
    else:
        max_x_axis_exp = np.log(x_max)
    x_limits = (np.exp(-max_x_axis_exp), np.exp(max_x_axis_exp))
    palette = sns.color_palette("Paired")
    colours = [palette[1], palette[0]]
    colours[1] = tuple((c * 0.8 for c in colours[1]))
    updated_theme = {"font.size": 9, "xtick.labelsize": "small", "ytick.labelsize": "medium",
                     "axes.titlesize": "medium", "axes.grid.which": "major",
                     "xtick.bottom": True, "xtick.minor.size": 3.5, "xtick.major.size": 7}
    updated_theme.update(theme)
    p = (so.Plot(data=plot_or, y="iv", x="odds_r", xmin=ci_lo, xmax=ci_hi, color="*")
         .label(x="", y="")
         .limit(x=x_limits)
         # .layout(size=(9.5, 6), engine="constrained")
         .theme(updated_theme)
         .scale(color=colours)
         .add(so.Dots(pointsize=6, fillalpha=1.0, artist_kws={"zorder": 2.5}))
         .add(so.Range())
         .add(so.Dash(), x=ci_lo, width=0.2)
         .add(so.Dash(), x=ci_hi, width=0.2)
         )
    if type(results_or_final.index) is pd.MultiIndex:
        p = p.facet("dv", wrap=wrap)
    fig_str = assets_output + f"Figure_{f_i}.svg"
    pl = p.on(fig).plot()
    # txt_bb = txt.get_window_extent(renderer=fig.canvas.get_renderer())
    # fig.get_layout_engine().set(h_pad=(6/72, 0))
    fig.legends.pop(0)
    plt.xscale("log")
    for ax in fig.axes:
        ax.axvline(x=1, color="black", alpha=0.5, linestyle=(0, (5, 3)), zorder=1.01)
        ax.xaxis.grid(True, which="major")
        # ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.LogFormatterExponent())
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(matplotlib.ticker.StrMethodFormatter("{x:g}"))
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,1], pad=0.5, h_pad=1)
    fig.savefig(fig_str)
    return fig_str, fig
```

## Collect dependent variables

```{python}
#| output: asis
dv_dict = {}
#####################################
# 3.1 Entry point into BAHSA services
#####################################
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
rt_entries["pathway"] = rt_entries["svc_type_short"]
rt_entries["pathway_type"] = (rt_entries["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
dv_dict["Entry point into BAHSA services (pathway type and level)"] = (
    rt_entries[["route_id", "pathway_type", "pathway_level"]].set_index("route_id"))
#################################################
# 3.1.1 Entry point into BAHSA: pathway and level
#################################################
rt_entries = dpw_rt_starts.copy()
print(f"Routes: {len(rt_entries):,}")
rt_entries["pway_and_lvl"] = rt_entries["svc_typelvl"]
dv_dict["Entry point into BAHSA services (pathway and level)"] = (
    rt_entries[["route_id", "pway_and_lvl"]].set_index("route_id"))
#####################################
# 3.2 Route outcomes after 3.08 years
#####################################
periodMult = {"d": 1, "m": 365.25/12, "y": 365.25}
years = periodMult["y"]
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_rt_ends.set_index("route_id", drop=False)
end_cols_to_drop = dpw_rt_ends.columns[
    (
        dpw_rt_ends.columns.isin(["gap", "dur"])
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("prev_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("vac_")
        | dpw_rt_ends.columns.str.startswith("pl_")
    )]
dpw_routes = dpw_rt_ends.drop(columns=end_cols_to_drop)
dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] = dpw_rt_starts.set_index("route_id")["pl_start_dt"].rename("rt_start_dt")
dpw_routes["rt_end_dt"] = dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"].rename("rt_end_dt")
# Set up map from categories to outcomes
rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}
dpw_rt_outcomes = dpw_routes[
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    (dpw_routes["rt_start_dt"] <= distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_measure)
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to an outcome
    & (dpw_routes["rt_end_cat"].isin(rt_end_cat_map.keys()))]
dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_outcome"] = dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_cat"].map(rt_end_cat_map)
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure)),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure).rename("rt_timemeasure_dt")
rt_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_rt_timemeasure_dt, on="route_id", how="inner")
rt_pls_at_timemeasures = rt_pls[(rt_pls["pl_start_dt"] < rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                & (
                                    rt_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                    | (rt_pls["pl_end_dt"] > rt_pls["rt_timemeasure_dt"])
                                )].set_index("route_id")
dpw_rt_outcomes.loc[
    (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_end_dt"] > (dpw_rt_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] + time_measure))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"]))
    & (rt_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No"),
    "rt_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dv_dict["Route outcomes after 3.08 years"] = (
                          dpw_rt_outcomes[["route_id", "rt_outcome"]].set_index("route_id"))
#######################################################################
# 3.3 Outcomes at a period of time after a person's first route started
#######################################################################
# dpw_cli_outcomes is the dpw_rt_outcome that is active after the measured time since the person's first route started
time_measure = pd.Timedelta(days=(3.08 * years))
# Relevant date for each client is their first route start date plus the time measure period
dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt = (dpw_rt_outcomes
                          .set_index("o_cli_id")
                          .groupby("o_cli_id")
                          .head(1)
                          ["rt_start_dt"]
                          + time_measure).rename("cli_timemeasure_dt")
dpw_cli_outcomes = dpw_rt_outcomes.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id").set_index("o_cli_id")
# Select the latest route that started before the outcome date
dpw_cli_outcomes = ((dpw_cli_outcomes[dpw_cli_outcomes["rt_start_dt"] <= dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_timemeasure_dt"]])
                    .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)).rename(columns={"rt_outcome": "cli_outcome"})
cli_pls = dpw_pls.join(dpw_cli_timemeasure_dt, on="o_cli_id")
cli_pls_at_timemeasures = cli_pls[(cli_pls["pl_start_dt"] < cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  & (
                                      cli_pls["pl_end_dt"].isna()
                                      | (cli_pls["pl_end_dt"] > cli_pls["cli_timemeasure_dt"])
                                  )].set_index("o_cli_id")
# Still being in supported accommodation is generally an insecure outcome
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[cli_pls_at_timemeasures.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Insecure outcome"
# But being in level 3 or 4 of the homelessness pathways in self-contained (not shared)
# means having your own flat with support staff occasionally visiting, i.e. similar
# to independent accommdoation
equiv_ind_at_time = cli_pls_at_timemeasures[
    (cli_pls_at_timemeasures["shared"] == "No")
    & cli_pls_at_timemeasures["pathway_level"].isin(["3", "4"])]
dpw_cli_outcomes.loc[equiv_ind_at_time.index, "cli_outcome"] = "Independent accommodation"
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_start_dt"] = (dpw_rt_starts.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                    .groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)["pl_start_dt"])
dpw_cli_outcomes["cli_end_dt"] = (dpw_rt_ends.set_index("o_cli_id")
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").tail(1)["pl_end_dt"])
dv_dict["Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"] = (
                          dpw_cli_outcomes[["cli_outcome"]])
##############################################
# 3.4 Returning to use services multiple times
##############################################
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["multiple_returns"] = (dpw_rt_starts.groupby(['o_cli_id']).size() >= 3).rename("multiple_returns")
dv_dict["People with multiple returns during 7.5 yrs"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["multiple_returns"]])
################################
# 3.5 Using services longer-term
################################
durations = dpw_pls.set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[["dur", "pl_start_dt"]]
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur"].dt.days
durations["dur_days"] = durations["dur_days"].fillna(1 + (distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - durations.pl_start_dt).dt.days)
durations = durations.drop(columns=["dur", "pl_start_dt"]).groupby(["o_cli_id", "route_id"]).sum()
# Set threshold to top 10% of route durations
longer_term_threshold_days = durations.quantile(0.9)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1).set_index("o_cli_id")
dpw_clis["has_longer_term_rt"] = ((durations > longer_term_threshold_days)
                                  .groupby("o_cli_id").any())
dv_dict["People with a route in top 10% of route durations"] = (
                          dpw_clis[["has_longer_term_rt"]])
######################################################################
# 3.6 Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation
######################################################################
# Note: Not enough returns after moves to independent accommodation to analyse much further.
# time_measure options: ['90d', '6m', '15m', '18m', '2y', '5y']
time_measure = "2y"
time_offset = distinct_pathways.stable_offsets[time_measure]
return_col = f"after_rt_ret_within_{time_measure}"
eligible_route_ends = dpw_rt_ends[
    # Only include routes that have a rt_end_cat that corresponds to independent accommodation
    dpw_rt_ends["rt_end_cat"].isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"])
    # Only include routes where there has been long enough for the outcome to happen
    & (dpw_rt_ends["pl_end_dt"] < distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt - time_offset)]
dv_dict["Returns within 2 years after moving to independent accommodation"] = (
                          eligible_route_ends[["route_id", return_col]].set_index("route_id"))
#########################################
# 3.7 Outcomes from individual placements
#########################################
pl_excluded = {}
pl_end_cat_map = routes.get_end_cats_map()
pl_outcomes = dpw_pls.set_index("vac_id")
pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_reason"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
next_pls = (dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_vac_id"].notna()]
            .rename(columns={"vac_id": "next_vac_id", "prev_vac_id": "vac_id", "svc_type_short": "pathway"})
            .set_index("vac_id"))
next_pls["pathway"] = next_pls["pathway"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes.loc[next_pls.index, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move"
pl_outcomes.loc[dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls["prev_svc_id"] == dpw_pls["svc_id"], "prev_vac_id"].values, "pl_end_cat"] = "Internal move: same service"
pl_outcomes["pathway"] = pl_outcomes["svc_type_short"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
pl_outcomes["pathway_type"] = (pl_outcomes["pathway"] == "Substance Misuse Pathway").map({True: "Substance Misuse", False: "Homelessness"})
pl_outcomes["ended"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "Current", False: "Ended"})
level_diff = (pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] == "Internal move", ["pathway", "pathway_level"]]
              .join(next_pls[["pathway", "pathway_level"]].add_prefix("next_"))
              .assign(level_diff=lambda df: df[["pathway_level", "next_pathway_level"]]
              .astype("Int64").diff(axis=1).iloc[:, -1]))
# Difference in level is meaningful except that moves to/from SU pathway are different..
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes.join((level_diff[["next_pathway_level", "level_diff"]]
                                .where((level_diff["pathway"] == level_diff["next_pathway"])
                                       | (level_diff["pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway")
                                       | (level_diff["next_pathway"] != "Substance Misuse Pathway"))))
pl_outcomes.loc[pl_outcomes["level_diff"].notna(), "pl_end_cat"] = (
    "Internal move: " + np.sign(pl_outcomes.level_diff).map({-1: "backwards", 0: "sideways", 1: "forwards"})
)
# Exclude 738 placements that have not ended
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"].notna()]
# Exclude 42 0-day placements
pl_outcomes = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["dur"] > pd.Timedelta(days=0)]
pl_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome (external)': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', '[Not ended]', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
pl_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in pl_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in pl_outcomes_map[outcome]}
pl_outcomes["pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].map(pl_end_cat_map)
pl_outcomes.loc[
    pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"].fillna("").str.startswith("Internal move"),
    "pl_outcome"] = pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"]
# Exclude 1,310 moves within the same service
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes[pl_outcomes["pl_end_cat"] != "Internal move: same service"]
# Exclude 277 moves due to end reasons: 53 missing reaons, 200 "Other"
# TODO: Should "Other" really be excluded?
pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc = pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc[pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc["pl_outcome"].notna()]
dv_dict["Outcomes from individual placements"] = (
                              pl_outcomes_excl_same_svc[["pl_outcome"]])
dv_dict_desc = list(dv_dict.keys())
dv_dict_cats = {k: list(v.iloc[:, 0].astype("string").fillna("<N/A>").unique()) for k, v in dv_dict.items()}
display(dv_dict_desc)
```

## Collect independent variables
```{python}
#| output: asis
from collections import defaultdict
dpw_pls = dpw_pls_orig
# Add route entry point as an IV as well as a DV
tdf = dv_dict["Entry point into BAHSA services (pathway type and level)"]
rt_entry_point = (tdf["pathway_type"].map({"Homelessness": "H ", "Substance Misuse": "SU "})
                  + tdf["pathway_level"].astype("string")).rename("rt_entry_point").astype("category")
dpw_pls = dpw_pls.join(rt_entry_point, on="route_id")
# Age category at year of first route during studied period
dpw_pls["gender"] = dpw_pls["gender"].map({

}).astype("category")
dpw_pls["age_cat"] = (dpw_pls["pl_start_dt"].dt.year - dpw_pls["yob"]>= 35).map({True: "35+", False: "34-"}).astype("category")

dpw_pls["global_majority"] = dpw_pls["ethnicity"].map(defaultdict(
    lambda: True,
    {
      "English/Welsh/Scottish/Northern Irish/British": False, "White British": False,

eth_dtl_map = {

}
mapper = {k: v for v, k in pd.Series(eth_dtl_map).explode().items()}
dpw_pls["ethnicity_detailed"] = dpw_pls["ethnicity"].replace(mapper).astype("string").astype("category")
eth_grp_map = {
    "White": [
        "White British",

}
mapper = {k: v for v,k in pd.Series(eth_grp_map).explode().items()}

dpw_pls["lgbtq_plus"] = dpw_pls["sexual_orientation"].map({

}).astype("boolean")
dpw_pls["uk_immigration_status"] = dpw_pls["uk_immigration_status"].map({

ref_cats = dpw_pls["ref_agency"].cat.categories

dpw_pls
```

# Route outcomes after 3.08 years

## Prepare DV

```{python}
# Get DV
dv_str = "Route outcomes after 3.08 years"
dv = dv_dict[dv_str].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])
```

## Prepare IVs

```{python}
selected_ch = {
    "demographics":  ["gender", "age_cat", "global_majority", "lgbtq_plus",
                      # "ethnicity_detailed", "ethnicity_grouped",
                      # "uk_immigration_status", "english_2nd_language",
                      ],
    "ethnicity_related": ["ethnicity_grouped", "uk_immigration_status"],
    "support_needs": ["offending", "physical_health", "mental_health", "substance_use", "multiple_disadvantage",
                      "rough_sleeping", "sex_working", "risk_violence_abuse", "risk_exploitation",],
    "route_variables": ["referral_agency", "rt_duration_weeks", "rt_entry_point",]
}
cols_to_exclude = []
X, Xc, iv_df, iv_cols_used, ref_cats, binaries, dummy_cols = get_ivs(dv, cols_to_exclude, selected_ch)
```

## Model building

### Start with block for demographic variables

```{python}
block_ch = list(selected_ch.values())[0]
block_ch_d = ["(Intercept)"] + cols_with_dummies(block_ch, dummy_cols)
```

### Test associations between IVs for initial block

#### Cramer's V 
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
p values indicated by asterisks: `***` if `p < 0.001`, `**` if `p < 0.01`, `*` if `p < 0.05` 
```{python}
chi2_crv_results, disp = iv_assoc(iv_df, block_ch)
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(disp)
```
:::

#### Variance Inflation Factor (VIF)
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
# Test multicollinearity with VIF
vif_data = vif(Xc[block_ch_d[1:]])
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)
```
:::

### MNLogit iteration 0
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
cols_to_remove = []
values_to_remove = []
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(dv, Xc[block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

### MNLogit iteration 1
Recode `gender=Non-Binary` as missing because there are too few data points: recode variable.

::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
selected_dv, selected_xc, sel_block_ch_d = dv_xc_remove_value(dv, Xc, block_ch_d, "gender_Non-Binary")
# cols_to_remove += ["gender_Non-Binary"]
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(selected_dv, selected_xc[sel_block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

All variables have significant findings. ALl are associated with reducing the odds of negative outcomes (compared to independent accommodation).

### Add block for grouped ethnicity data and drop "global_majority"
```{python}
new_block_ch = selected_ch["ethnicity_related"]
sel_block_ch = [ch for ch in block_ch + new_block_ch if ch != "global_majority"]
sel_block_ch_d = [ch for ch in sel_block_ch_d + cols_with_dummies(new_block_ch, dummy_cols) if ch != "global_majority"]
```

### Test associations between IVs now a block has been added

#### Cramer's V

p values indicated by asterisks: `***` if `p < 0.001`, `**` if `p < 0.01`, `*` if `p < 0.05`

```{python}
chi2_crv_results, disp = iv_assoc(iv_df, sel_block_ch)
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(disp)
```
:::
#### Variance Inflation Factor (VIF)
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
# Test multicollinearity with VIF
vif_data = vif(Xc[sel_block_ch_d[1:]])
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)
```
:::

No significant multicollinearity. Proceeding with MNLogit.

### MNLogit iteration 2
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(selected_dv, selected_xc[sel_block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

Model did not converge because no-one with Mixed Heritage ethnicity died in accommodation -- recoding as "other"
```{python}
selected_xc.loc[selected_xc["ethnicity_grouped_Mixed Heritage"], "ethnicity_grouped_Other"] = True
selected_xc = selected_xc.drop(columns="ethnicity_grouped_Mixed Heritage")
for lst in [sel_block_ch_d, dummy_cols["ethnicity_grouped"]]:
```

# Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started

## Prepare DV

```{python}
# Get DV
dv_str = "Outcomes 3.08 years after a person's first route started"
dv = dv_dict[dv_str].iloc[:, 0].astype("category")
dv = dv.cat.reorder_categories(['Independent accommodation', 'Insecure outcome', 'Returned to homelessness', 'Died'])
```

## Prepare IVs

```{python}
selected_ch = {
    "demographics":  ["gender", "age_cat", "global_majority", "lgbtq_plus",
                      # "ethnicity_detailed", "ethnicity_grouped",
                      # "uk_immigration_status", "english_2nd_language",
                      ],
    "ethnicity_related": ["ethnicity_grouped", "uk_immigration_status"],
    "support_needs": ["offending", "physical_health", "mental_health", "substance_use", "multiple_disadvantage",
                      "rough_sleeping", "sex_working", "risk_violence_abuse", "risk_exploitation",],
    # "route_variables": ["referral_agency", "rt_duration_weeks", "rt_entry_point",]
}
cols_to_exclude = []
X, Xc, iv_df, iv_cols_used, ref_cats, binaries, dummy_cols = get_ivs(dv, cols_to_exclude, selected_ch)
```

## Model building

### Start with block for demographic variables

```{python}
block_ch = list(selected_ch.values())[0]
block_ch_d = ["(Intercept)"] + cols_with_dummies(block_ch, dummy_cols)
```

### Test associations between IVs for initial block

#### Cramer's V 
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
p values indicated by asterisks: `***` if `p < 0.001`, `**` if `p < 0.01`, `*` if `p < 0.05` 
```{python}
chi2_crv_results, disp = iv_assoc(iv_df, block_ch)
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(disp)
```
:::

#### Variance Inflation Factor (VIF)
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
# Test multicollinearity with VIF
vif_data = vif(Xc[block_ch_d[1:]])
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(vif_data)
```
:::

### MNLogit iteration 0
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
cols_to_remove = []
values_to_remove = []
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(dv, Xc[block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

### MNLogit iteration 1
Recode `gender=Non-Binary` as missing because there are too few data points: recode variable.

::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
selected_dv, selected_xc, sel_block_ch_d = dv_xc_remove_value(dv, Xc, block_ch_d, "gender_Non-Binary")
# cols_to_remove += ["gender_Non-Binary"]
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(selected_dv, selected_xc[sel_block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

`lgbtq_plus` not significant as variance better explained by other variables

### MNLogit iteration 2
::: {.callout-note collapse=true title="Results"}
```{python}
cols_to_remove += ["lgbtq_plus"]
results, summary, results_or = multinomial_regression(selected_dv, selected_xc[sel_block_ch_d], cols_to_remove, dummy_cols)
```
:::

All remaining variables have significant findings. All are associated with reducing the odds of negative outcomes
(compared to independent accommodation), apart from being 34 or younger which is associated with increased odds of
returning to homelessness.


## Final model

```{python}
from io import StringIO

display(summary)
results_or_final = (results_or.drop(columns=["prev_coef", "coef", "diff_pct"], errors="ignore")
                    .swaplevel().sort_index()
                    .reindex(cat_order[1:], level=0))
with pd.option_context("display.float_format", "{:,.3f}".format):
    display(results_or_final)

tbl_i = 0
comp_cats = [x[0] for x in results.summary().tables[1].data if x[0].startswith(results.model.endog_names)]
for tbl in results.summary2().tables:
    if tbl_i != 0:
        tbl = tbl.rename(columns={tbl.columns[0]: comp_cats[tbl_i - 1]})
    excel_output[f"MNLogit: '{dv_str} (vs independent accommodation)', table {tbl_i}"] = tbl
    tbl_i += 1
excel_output[f"MNLogit: '{dv_str} (vs independent accommodation)', odds ratios"] = results_or_final
```

## Visualisation

```{python}
from itertools import product
figure_minor_i += 1
theme = {"ytick.labelsize": "medium"}
ref_cats_used = {k: v for k, v in ref_cats.items() if k in ["gender", "age_cat", "ethnicity_grouped", "uk_immigration_status"]}
shorter_iv = {r"uk\ immigration\ status": "immigration"}
cols_removed = cols_to_remove
cols_removed = [col for col in cols_to_remove if col != "multiple_disadvantage"]
for or_section, i_sub in [(slice(0, 3), "a"), (slice(3, None), "b")]:
    save_fmi = figure_minor_i
    temp_res_or = results_or_final.loc[results_or_final.index.levels[0][or_section]].copy()
    temp_res_or.index = temp_res_or.index.remove_unused_levels()
    figure_minor_i = str(figure_minor_i) + i_sub
    fig_str, fig = plot_odds_r(dv_str, dv.cat.categories[0], ref_cats_used, temp_res_or, replacements=shorter_iv, theme=theme, cols_removed=cols_removed)
    plt.show(block=False)
    figure_minor_i = save_fmi
```

# Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
    float_format = writer.book.add_format({"num_format": "#,##0.000"})
    writer.sheets[sheetname].set_column("B:H", None, float_format)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
